_note: IP2025 data-model extract. Two layers: (1) the 6 top-level .xsd files, which are NOT the project data model but per-feature tool-configuration schemas (cased-hole, formation-testing, image tools, code sanitizing, user-program menu registration); (2) the ACTUAL IP project/well/curve data model, recovered from the public .NET object model documented in PGL.IP.API.xml (Tier A structural facts, no algorithm code). Source read-only: C:\Program Files\IP2025.

xsd_schemas._summary: 6 XSD files at install root. Only tool/feature config schemas ship as XSD; the core project data model is binary (.pgw/DLIS-like) and is described by the API object model, not by an XSD.

files.purpose: Declares a cased-hole logging tool's input-curve map and cement/casing lookup parameters. Tool has ~60 optional named input-curve slots.
files.tier: Tier A structure; underlying CBL/SBT/impedance math is Tier B/vendor

files.purpose: Wireline formation-tester (pretest / RFT / MDT) tool + probe drawdown Model definition.
files.tier: Tier B (pretest permeability/mobility from drawdown is published; see FTOutputCurves)

files.purpose: Borehole-image / dipmeter / caliper tool geometry + navigation + rendering config. Abstract Tool base -> RotationalTool (Acoustic/LWD/Scan360/Image360/MIT) and StageArmPadTool (PadBased/Dipmeter/Caliper).
files.tier: Tier A structure; DTA/Experienced-Eye/entropy speed-correction image algorithms are Tier C (do NOT extract)

files.purpose: Shared value/curve/pad/button primitive types included by ImageTool.xsd (CurveDefinition, ScalarValue+Units, Delay/Angle/Length/Velocity/Slowness value types, Pad/ButtonRow/ButtonCollection).

Serialization schema for code/unit 'sanitizing' maps: attribute groups codeSanitizing(code->sanitizedCode) and unitSanitizing(unit->sanitizedUnit). Used to normalise illegal mnemonic/unit strings on import. Legacy (OmniWorks history stamp 2006).

Manifest schema for a user-registered module (menu integration), NOT algorithm: menupath/siblingnode/displayat/caption/tooltip/helpid/autorun/separator/requireswell. Pairs with the compiled UserProgram.dll module system.
files.tier: Tier A (structure); note UserProgram.dll module algorithm code is compiled - do not decompile

ip_project_object_model._summary: Recovered from PGL.IP.API.xml (.NET XML-doc for the public IP API, PGL.IP.API namespace). This IS IP's project data model. Hierarchy: Database -> Well -> CurveSet -> Curve, with per-Well ZoneSets(->Zone->Parameter), Discriminators, ImagePickSets, and header/location/identity blocks. Directly comparable to SandiBumi's DuckDB well/curveset/curve tables.
ip_project_object_model.hierarchy: IDatabase (project) -> IWell[] -> ICurveSet[] -> ICurve[] -> ILogReading/IArrayLogReading (samples); IWell also -> IZoneSet[] -> IZone[] -> IParameter[]

IDatabase.doc: A Database containing a collection of Wells (loaded + unloaded).

IWell.doc: A Well: header data + ZoneSets + Log Curves grouped in CurveSets.

IWellIdentity.note: Pwi = Petrophysical Well Identifier; the join key.

ICurveSet.doc: A Curve Set within a Well: a collection of Curves sampled against one shared DepthCurve.
ICurveSet.note: IP 'Set' == Techlog 'dataset' == Geolog 'set' == SandiBumi curve-set. All curves in a set share depth sampling.

ICurve.doc: A Curve within a CurveSet within a Well.

ICurveStatistics.note: Percentile1/2/3 -> supports GR P3/P97-style normalisation (Jauhar workflow).

ILogReading / IArrayLogReading.doc: Individual sample value (scalar) / array-per-depth sample (waveform/image) via enumerator.

IZoneSet.doc: A named Zone Set on a well (zonation / tops / a runnable model).
IZoneSet.note: a ZoneSet can be static tops OR a runnable interpretation model with input/output curves.

IParameter.note: per-zone interpretation constants (Rw, m, n, a, cutoffs...) attach here -> maps to SandiBumi zone-parameter store.

IDiscriminator / IDiscriminatorSet.doc: A single filter (min/max on a curve) / a set of them, controlling which curve values are displayed or counted (cutoff / net-pay flags).

comparison.vs_sandibumi_duckdb: IP hierarchy Database>Well>CurveSet>Curve maps 1:1 to SandiBumi's project>well>curveset>curve. Confirms design: (a) curves grouped into sets that share ONE depth curve + spacing (IsIrregular flag for uneven sampling); (b) per-zone parameters live on Zone objects, not global -> SandiBumi zone-parameter table is the right shape; (c) rich per-curve audit columns (create/update user+module+date, FinalVersion, Locked, CurveStatus) worth mirroring for provenance; (d) DepthReferenceType enum (MD/TVD_KB/GL/SS/SB) is the canonical datum set to store per curve; (e) ICurveStatistics ships Percentile1/2/3 -> aligns with GR P3/P97 normalisation.
comparison.vs_techlog: IP exposes its data model as a documented .NET object model (PGL.IP.API.xml) rather than as XSD; Techlog's equivalent was thin property-alias XMLs (Dlis/Las/Geolog/propertyDict). IP naming: Well/CurveSet/Curve/ZoneSet/Zone == Techlog Well/Dataset/Variable/Zoneset/Zone == Geolog Well/Set/Log/Zoneset. IP 'CurveSet' == Techlog 'dataset' == Geolog 'set'. Both tools group curves under a shared depth reference; IP additionally carries explicit array/waveform dimensions (XArraySize/XDimension/YDimension) on the curve.
